# 04 Migrate demos/complex-showcase.html onto @siren/board, then clean up shared CSS

## Outcome

`demos/complex-showcase.html` renders and behaves exactly as it does today, now via
`@siren/board`, with the same class of hand-rolled boilerplate deleted as in ticket 03. With both
demos migrated, `demos/demo-chrome.css`'s `#siren-container`/`.controls` rules are now genuinely
dead (board injects its own equivalents) and are deleted — leaving `demo-chrome.css` owning only
page header chrome (`h1`/`.intro`/`.status`/dark-theme text colors).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `demos/complex-showcase.html` imports `@siren/board`'s built output, same as ticket 03's
      `step-reveal.html`.
- [ ] Same deletions as ticket 03 apply here: hand-rolled `createBrowserTextMeasurer()`, the
      Prev/Next/Reset control wiring, and the `svg === null`/diagnostics console-warning block are
      removed from the page's script; the static `<div class="controls">` Prev/Next/Reset markup
      is removed from the HTML. The Theme button and its handler stay (page-owned).
  - Note: this file's script/comments diverge slightly from `step-reveal.html`'s (different intro
    text, different `.srn` source path, a comment about pre-verified transitions) — preserve that
    page-specific content, don't just copy `step-reveal.html`'s script verbatim.
- [ ] `demos/demo-chrome.css`'s `#siren-container` and `.controls`-related rules (light and
      dark-theme variants) are deleted now that neither demo page uses those classes anymore.
- [ ] Visually verified (headless-Chrome screenshot): full-bleed canvas, floating control bar
      (built-in), intro text and 22-step description at top, dark-theme toggle still works, and
      stepping through `next()`/`prev()` still shows the branch-and-merge flowchart's enter/exit/
      highlight/unhighlight transitions correctly (spot-check a few steps, not all 22).
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @siren/core build && pnpm --filter @siren/board build`, then serving the repo
      root over http(s) and loading both demo pages, produces no console errors on either page.

## Test seam

Same as ticket 03: manual/visual verification via headless-Chrome screenshot, not a new automated
test — `@siren/board`'s behavior is already covered by tickets 01/02.

- `demos/complex-showcase.html`
